title: Planet radius distribution
description: Distribution among planets with reported positive radii; missing radii are excluded.

title: Planet mass distribution
description: Log-scaled masses among planets with mass estimates; different mass-estimation methods may be represented.

title: Orbital period distribution
description: Reported positive orbital periods on a logarithmic axis; missing periods are excluded.

title: Planet radius: spread and outliers
description: Boxplot whiskers use a statistical convention; points beyond them are not automatically errors.

title: Planet mass versus radius
description: Only planets with both measurements appear; association does not establish causation.

title: Orbital period versus orbital distance
description: A relationship is expected from orbital mechanics; host-star mass also matters.

title: Planets by discovery method
description: These are catalogue counts, not a comparison of intrinsic method quality or universe-wide occurrence.

title: Discoveries by year
description: Counts reflect discoveries recorded in this catalogue; the current year may be incomplete.

title: Host-star temperature versus planet radius
description: Only systems with both measurements appear; discovery selection may influence the pattern.

title: Pairwise Pearson correlations
description: Each correlation uses available pairs and may have a different sample size; Pearson r measures linear association only.
